source: COPY_FILE and RENAME_FILE with repeated adjacent or separated destination stars
substitution: Each star reuses the whole directory name, filename stem or extension in its own part; no recursive insertion or wildcard-substring captures
depth: One source level per ordinary star-containing directory component, including pre_** and ***; one optional whole ** inserts remaining levels while reserving suffix components
admission: Capture source/target/status once; validate all expanded paths/depth, collisions, aliases, busy handles, rescans, payloads and quotas before publication
backends: Explicit ordinary, virtual-volume, rooted and configured plain PIP banks; existing overwrite and guarded cross-bank rules
bounds: 254-character input/expanded names; 32767 scanned entries; 64 MiB COPY snapshots; existing budgets and backend quotas
publication: Prepared logical state, retained rename bytes and device garbage; rooted per-file host errors may retain earlier changes
persistence: Result bytes/accounting only; no templates, scans, handles or pending plans
boundary: Directory questions follow directory_question_capture_policy; no bracket destination templates, multiple whole-directory ** placeholders, directory creation/search, host transactions or native/controller/strict equivalence; filename questions retain separate fixed-width capture rules
